newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines Jan-Apr budget surplus rises.
newsitem.headline: Philippines Jan-Apr budget surplus rises.

text.p: The Philippines posted an 18.2 billion peso budget surplus in the first four months of the year, higher than 13.7 billion surplus in the same period last year, Finance Secretary Roberto de Ocampo said on Thursday.
The level was also higher than the 11 billion peso surplus set for for the period.
Revenue collection rose to 151.6 billion pesos as compared with 144.8 billion registered last year.
Expenditures grew to 133.4 bilion pesos from 131.1 billion last year.

"Improving macro fundamentals are expected to contribute to a stronger growth performance in the months ahead ... This latest information belies unfounded rumours that the Philippines is going Thailand's way," de Ocampo said.
